Subject: Query: e-invoicing formats and billing contact for Redwood invoices

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

We're finalizing our AP intake for Q4 and need to confirm how Redwood can deliver invoices for Bluefin Labs. Two quick things:

1) Can Redwood send invoices via PEPPOL/UBL to our gateway? If not, can you provide an XML schema (UBL) or a PDF with structured VAT fields we can auto-ingest?

2) Who should be the canonical billing contact at Redwood for AP follow-ups (PO issues, VAT breakdowns)? We prefer a single inbox that our ERP can map to.

I've attached PO-4721 for context (expected monthly usage). If you can reply with the preferred delivery options and a short list of required fields (VAT number, invoice currency, tax breakdown), we can route the integration request to our technical team.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Query: e-invoicing formats and billing contact for Redwood invoices

Hi Sophie — thanks for the context and the PO.

Short answer: we support three delivery patterns today:
- Standard PDF emailed to a billing address (PDF includes VAT number and line-level tax breakdown)
- Portal delivery via our billing portal (preferred for high-volume customers; webhookable notifications)
- Structured invoices (XML/UBL) via a connector or direct PEPPOL push — we can enable this but it requires a short setup (endpoint + certificate).

I attached a one-page breakdown of the options and required fields (e-invoice-options.pdf). For PEPPOL we need your gateway endpoint and whether you require signed/secure submissions. If we proceed with PEPPOL we'll also need a signed mandate (DocuSign or equivalent).

For a canonical billing contact, our recommended flow is to use a single mailbox that routes to AP: billing-ops@redwood.com. If Bluefin requires invoices to come from a named Redwood contact for vendor setup, I can be the primary contact during setup and then hand off to billing-ops.

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm gateway endpoint + certificate requirement.
2) We run a test invoice to your staging gateway.
3) Sign the e-invoice mandate (I can send a DocuSign link).

Would you be available for a 30-min call tomorrow to lock the details?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachment: e-invoice-options.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks, Stephanie — this is helpful. A few clarifications from the Bluefin AP team:

- We prefer an automated PEPPOL submission into our gateway (production) but can accept a staging push first.
- We do require signed submissions (certificate exchange).
- The fields we need: Supplier VAT (with country code), Invoice-level tax total, Line-level tax breakdown, Currency, Invoice number, PO reference.

I've attached our gateway endpoint and a sample mapping file for your integration team. If you can send a test UBL/PEPPOL envelope to the endpoint in staging, we'll confirm the mapping.

Also — for vendor setup we need a named Redwood billing contact for the vendor file; billing-ops@redwood.com is fine, but please list an individual contact as a backup.

Sophie
